name: Chameleonic Scales (Heritage)
body:
You have the ability to change the coloration of your scales.

Prerequisite(s): Reptilian subtype.

Benefit(s): As a move action, you can change the color of your scales to match the environment around you. As long as you do not move from your space or otherwise draw attention to yourself, you gain a +10 circumstance bonus on Stealth checks, and once hidden, can remain hidden even while observed (although you cannot activate this ability while observed).
